question: How can Shiva be said to have many powers without losing unity?
premises: Shiva is endowed with the power of freedom.
He is also spoken of as having many powers.
These many powers are not separate from that one power.
inference: Shiva's many powers are expressions of his one power of freedom and do not compromise his unity.
plain_english: So the straightforward conclusion is that Shiva is endowed with the power of freedom. Even when he is said to have many powers, those powers are not separate from that one power.
